description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer, surrogate, and copier for the NameValueCollection class within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines how NameValueCollection objects are serialized, deserialized, and deep-copied, including associated surrogate and copier classes.

classes.name: NameValueCollectionCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for NameValueCollection, converting to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: NameValueCollectionSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate data structure used to serialize NameValueCollection.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a NameValueCollection instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a NameValueCollection into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a NameValueCollection instance.
